name: Immaculate Conception Cathedral, Comayagua
scope: Present-day cathedral exterior. Include the plaza frontage, north clock and bell tower, the nave and side aisles, and the attached sacristy and chapel. Preserve the open court where supported by the plan.
era: Standing cathedral with historic elevation features corroborated by the primary restoration and municipal accounts.

externalReferences.artist: Engraving attributed to E. G. Squier through the 1859 article
externalReferences.publicationTitle: Harper’s New Monthly Magazine, volume 19, number 113, October 1859, printed page 603.

originalReview.caption: Cathedral of Comayagua.
originalReview.notes: West and south elevation rhythm, single domed tower, relief, large arched portal, and side-wall openings. Verify the clock and standing features using written restoration evidence. The historic atrium rail and foreground figures belong to the illustration period.

review.method: Verified original published engraving and holding library record
review.notes: Started with Qualla’s published image inventory. Historic Qualla candidates lacked source publication or exact postcard identity. Attribution-only modern images were excluded. The October 1859 original publication is the selected image source.
